name: ignite
description: Ignite language support: syntax highlighting and the diagnostics of ignite check through ignite-lsp

ignite.lsp.path.markdownDescription: Path of `ignite-lsp`. Empty: `ignite-lsp` on `PATH`, else the binary of the latest release of github.com/ignite-lang/ignite-lsp, downloaded once into the extension's storage.

ignite.path.markdownDescription: Path of the `ignite` compiler the server runs for `ignite check`. Empty: `ignite` on `PATH`, else the latest release of github.com/ignite-lang/ignite, downloaded once into the extension's storage.

ignite.trace.server.description: Trace the messages between VS Code and ignite-lsp in the output channel.
